a.lede: Kora is set to launch as a free-to-use alternative to Windows, targeting users who rely heavily on AI models and agents.
a.title: After challenging Google’s Android with Cyanogen, its co-founder takes aim at Windows for AI era

b.lede: Kora, a Linux desktop OS with built-in AI models and agents for local agentic work, is coming to PCs in 2027, including Snapdragon X2 Elite machines.
b.title: Cyanogen co-founder unveils Kora, a Linux OS that splits AI models across the CPU, GPU, and NPU
